classes.name: Store
classes.description: This class provides methods to retrieve store information, create store instances, and manage store data within the OpenCart catalog setting namespace.

methods.name: getStore
methods.description: Retrieves store details by store ID from the database.

methods.name: getStoreByHostname
methods.description: Retrieves store details based on a provided hostname URL.

methods.name: getStores
methods.description: Retrieves a list of all stores, utilizing caching for efficiency.

methods.name: createStoreInstance
methods.description: Creates and initializes a new store instance with specified store ID, language, and session ID.
